justification: The brief runs the full flood, bushfire and shadow pipelines and then discarded most of each result at the Pydantic contract layer, so the flagship product understated what its own engines computed — a live Kincumber run returned a moderate flood screening signal and a recorded 2022 Copernicus flood extent that the page rendered as effectively clear. Widening the contracts is regulatory-adjacent user-facing surface, so every new field keeps three-state semantics and every new sentence carries mapped-extent register wording pinned by tests.

pre_impl.existing_data: A live full-pipeline run for 20 Patanga Street Kincumber captured on 2026-07-16 showed the flood service returning a moderate screening signal with a Copernicus EMSR567 flood extent intersecting the lot, the bushfire service returning BAL cost guidance and clearing wording, and the shadow service returning five scenarios with low confidence — while the brief card rendered roughly five flood values and one shadow line.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The narrowing was in the FloodServiceOutput and BushfireServiceOutput whitelists and the shadow render, not in the pipelines — the compute was already paid on every satellite brief run and the fields were discarded between the service return and the card.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Follows the terrain card pattern that already passes the service model through wholesale; extends the existing SectionData render registries and the existing field-coverage ratchet baseline additively rather than forking a new card style or a parallel contract.

functions.name: _build_flood_detail
functions.input: the raw dict returned by the flood service including the screening signal, per-source evidence fields and the Copernicus activation list
functions.output: a FloodDetail carrying all twenty-three mapped fields with None for anything the service did not return, so the card can render exactly what the engine computed
functions.if_none: a missing or refused flood payload builds no detail and the section renders its existing unavailable state rather than a partial or invented result

values.value: flood detail ems_flood_detected with ems_activations and flood_signal
values.read_at: the flood card headline and the Copernicus sentence built by floodSignalLine and emsLine in satellite-copy.ts
values.if_missing: a None detection renders neither the mapped-extent sentence nor a clear claim, and a None signal renders no headline — three-state is preserved end to end

break_it.scenario: The flood service returns a payload where Copernicus data was unavailable so ems_flood_detected is None rather than False
break_it.what_happens: a boolean-minded render would print the no-extent-recorded sentence and turn a source outage into a clear claim
break_it.how: the EMS sentence renders only when the value is strictly true or strictly false and a None stays silent, pinned by the sparse-output mapping test
break_it.repro: build the flood detail from a payload with ems_flood_detected None and confirm the card output contains no Copernicus sentence

break_it.scenario: A shadow run computed at the standard two-storey fallback height with low confidence renders the ADG solar access line
break_it.what_happens: without the caveat the line reads as a definitive guideline result even though the height was assumed rather than mapped
break_it.how: ShadowDetailDisplay appends the computed-at-standard-height low-confidence caveat whenever height_source is default or confidence is low, and the construction-change note wins over the boolean so a Sentinel-2 timeout never reads as a clear
break_it.repro: render ShadowDetailDisplay with the Kincumber fixture and confirm the caveat text appears beside the ADG line

break_it.scenario: A cached bushfire row written before this widening flows into the widened contract on a later brief run
break_it.what_happens: the new compliance keys are absent from the stored payload and a strict reader could crash or invent defaults
break_it.how: every widened field is Optional with a None default so old rows validate and render as not-available, with the contract-drift tripwire logging the missing keys for observability
break_it.repro: validate a pre-widening bushfire payload against BushfireServiceOutput and confirm it parses with the new fields None

post_merge.manual_verify: Re-run the Kincumber brief with satellite on after deploy and confirm the flood card shows the moderate screening signal and the 2022 Copernicus mapped-extent sentence, the bushfire card shows the BAL typical-cost row with the assessor directory link and the conditional 10/50 wording, the shadow block shows all five scenario rows with the standard-height caveat, and the solar card shows pitch and azimuth.
